description: This Java source file defines a Spring-managed service class 'RecurringDepositAccountApplicationModificationCommandHandler' that handles commands to modify recurring deposit account applications within the Fineract microfinance platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the modification processing to the 'DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountApplicationModificationCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring @Service class that handles update commands for recurring deposit account applications by delegating to a write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to modify a recurring deposit application by calling the underlying service's modifyRDApplication method.
